name: Log Listening TCP Ports (Windows)
description: Append the machine’s listening TCP ports and the process IDs that own them to a log file on a schedule, so a service that starts listening unexpectedly shows up as a new line in the history instead of going unnoticed.
commandTemplate: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen | Sort-Object LocalPort | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-File -Append '{{logPath}}'"

parameters.label: Log file path
parameters.help: Where to append each snapshot. Compare snapshots over time to spot a new listener; this records what is open and does not judge whether it should be.
